newsitem.title: USA: Three killed in New Mexico plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in New Mexico plane crash.

text.p: Three men were killed when their small plane crashed Monday night in southeastern New Mexico, police said.
The twin-engine Beechcraft plane was flying toward El Paso, Texas, when it plunged into a high mountain plateau about 90 miles (140 km) northeast of Las Cruces.
"It clipped a telegraph poll, went into the ground and then burned," state police Lieut. William Bower said.
He said the victims were identified as Leroy Mooneyham and Donald Fenton from Austin, Texas, and Dean Labounty of Roswell, N.M.
Investigators from the Federal Aviation Administration and the National Transportation Safety Board were examining the wreckage Tuesday morning to determine the cause of the crash.
